id: #ids cannot be the same between items
Type:
Type should be:
Effects both 'drop' and 'linked'
Value:		for a value of said items
Random		for a random of said items.
Drop:
What drop value this creates.
2 types of drop:
groupID:number = drop this number from this id
groupID:axb means drop b credits worth of groupID a times. (so a would be item verity, bxa would be item value)
Linked: what drop random / drop value triggers this.
LinkedEntity:
What linked entity trigers this
this is required in addition to a linked random or linked value. leave blank for anything
multiplyerValue: multiplys the drop value / drop random values.
BaseValue:
The base drop random / drop value.
If total value is less then 0, this will not trigger.
loadPriority:
The load priority of this item 
set to higher values to override things from other mods, provided they have this setting for some reason...?
